pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0131 first-release agent contracts
pr_body:
## Summary

Closes remaining ADR 0131 managed runtime repair gaps found in the final audit. Frame-capture failures, runtime-input failures, evaluator launch/exit/poll failures, and evaluators that fail to resolve visual evidence now update the appropriate engine-owned completion gate and enter the bounded repair loop instead of leaving a run stuck.

Frame capture failure remains host-owned evidence and cannot be forged through provider completion events. Runtime repair now treats frame-capture failure as a first-class trigger and retains the existing two-attempt bound.
